تعتصمون (form VIII)
# تَعْتَصِمُونَ (taʕtaṣimūna) /taʕ.ta.sˤi.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَصَمَ (iʕtaṣama)
# تُعْتَصَمُونَ (tuʕtaṣamūna) /tuʕ.ta.sˤa.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَصَمَ (iʕtaṣama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
